task_description: Implement three user-requested features in the PlantSense AI Flutter app on a new branch off feat/plantsense-ai-app: (1) a first-launch PURPOSE/INTENT picker at app start reusing the existing SurveyPurpose enum, which sets the initial Home tab and seeds the GeoResearch survey purpose and is re-choosable from Settings; (2) fix inaccurate location by raising LocationAccuracy from low to high with a timeout; (3) an interactive map location picker (flutter_map + latlong2 + OpenStreetMap tiles, no API key) letting the user drop/drag a pin, reverse-geocode it, and selectManual. All strings localized EN+AR (fr/es English fallback) and hand-wired through all 5 generated l10n files since gen-l10n cannot run in this sandbox. Native needs go into both setup scripts. The user must run flutter pub get / analyze / test / dart format on their toolchain.

review.followups_addressed: Both non-blocking issues (post-confirm tab flicker; tile-error message reused geocodeFailed) fixed in commit 1986c87.

verification.summary: Sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY with no Flutter/Dart SDK and no internet, so flutter pub get / analyze / test / dart format and any docker build cannot run here; the user must run them on their Windows toolchain (documented for the PR body). Static verification is green: ARB key parity app_en.arb vs app_ar.arb == 418 keys each (empty symmetric difference); all 9 new l10n keys (purposeScreenTitle, purposeScreenSubtitle, purposeScreenContinue, settingsPurpose, locationPickOnMap, mapPickerTitle, mapPickerConfirm, mapDroppedPin, mapTileError) present as abstract getters and impls across all 5 generated files (es/fr English fallback); brace/paren balance 0/0 on all edited/new Dart files. Test quality reviewed and PASS: app_purpose_provider_test.dart exercises the real persistence/restore/tolerant-parse paths of AppPurposeNotifier; home_tab_for_purpose_test.dart covers the pure homeTabForPurpose mapping; map_picker_flow_test.dart drives the real LocationController.selectPinnedLocation for both reverse-geocode-success and null-fallback and would fail if that logic were reverted. Deps flutter_map ^7.0.2 + latlong2 ^0.9.1 added (no google_maps_flutter); location accuracy raised low->high with a 15s timeLimit; OSM tiles need only INTERNET which both setup scripts already add. Review v1 follow-up: (1) reordered the purpose fan-out in PurposeScreen._confirm and the Settings re-choose handler so the Home tab + survey seed are set before the awaited persisted purpose write (removes the one-frame Chat-tab flicker); (2) added the dedicated mapTileError string and used it in the map tile-load error banner instead of the mismatched geocodeFailed.
